name: LobsterMail
desc: Email infrastructure for AI agents — create inboxes, send and receive email, search, threads, and webhooks.

actions.name: create_inbox
actions.description: Create a new email inbox on LobsterMail.

actions.name: get_inbox
actions.description: Get details for a single inbox including its address, status, and settings.

actions.name: delete_inbox
actions.description: Permanently delete an inbox and release its address. This action cannot be undone.

actions.name: list_inboxes
actions.description: List all email inboxes on the account.

actions.name: send_email
actions.description: Send an email from one of your LobsterMail inboxes. Requires a verified account (Tier 1+).

actions.name: list_emails
actions.description: List emails in a specific inbox.

actions.name: get_email
actions.description: Get a single email with full body content.

actions.name: search_emails
actions.description: Search emails across inboxes using full-text search and optional filters. Rate limited to 30 requests/minute.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Get account details including subscription tier, usage, and sending limits.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_email
triggers.description: Triggers instantly when a new email is received in an inbox.

triggers.name: new_thread
triggers.description: Triggers when a brand-new conversation (thread) is started in an inbox.

triggers.name: thread_reply
triggers.description: Triggers when someone replies to an existing email thread. Useful for follow-up and support automation.

triggers.name: email_bounced
triggers.description: Triggers when an outbound email fails to deliver. Use this to update CRM records, retry with a different address, or alert your team.

triggers.name: email_sent
triggers.description: Triggers when an outbound email is successfully delivered. Use for audit logs, CRM updates, or confirming delivery.
